messages.subject: Your half-yearly retention statement is now available
messages.body:
Dear Client,

As required by regulation, we are sending you the half-yearly retention statement of funds and securities held in your account for the period 1 February 2026 to 31 July 2026.

Account: KS-4471-9920
Statement period: 01-Feb-2026 to 31-Jul-2026

The statement is attached and is also available under Reports in your account portal at https://portal.kestrel.example/reports.

This statement is provided for your records. No payment is due and no response is required.

Should you notice any discrepancy in the statement, please write to support@kestrel.example or contact your nearest branch within 30 days of receipt.

Please do not reply to this email. This mailbox is not monitored.

Regards,
Client Services
Kestrel Securities Limited

Registered with the Exchange. Investments are subject to market risk. Read all related documents carefully before investing.
